meta.stratum: DF voice: announcements, descriptor vocabulary, chronicle tone
sources: data/init/announcements.txt (353 announcement event IDs + channel flags)
Dwarf Fortress.exe binary strings (verified template fragments, byte-extracted)
meta.note: Fortress announcement strings are NOT raws in the Premium build; they live in the binary. announcements.txt defines the event taxonomy and per-event delivery flags. Templates below marked binary_* were extracted verbatim from the exe via grep -a. Templates marked gamelog_* are rendered lines observed in gamelog.txt.

legend.BOX: appears in a box and pauses the game

announcement_delivery_flags.grammar_lesson: DF separates WHAT happened (event ID) from HOW LOUD it is (flags). Dread scales by channel, not by wording.

death.source: binary fragments 'struck down' / 'been struck down.' / ', struck down by '
death.pattern: deaths read as passive verdicts: subject + 'has been struck down' — the killer arrives second.

mood.adventure_form: You are in a fey mood.
mood.note: mood adjectives are the emotional spectrum: fey, secretive, fell, macabre, possessed

templates_binary: A migrant has arrived at this ...

gangelog_rendered_examples: The child Gasom Opirodoh begins playing make believe.
The elf Yarare iromame stands up.
Wren Man Bowyer is no longer enraged.
There is nothing to hold here.
You begin the story of the false friendship of the elf Ari Bucklabor and the human Nemen Moprhythmic in Assaultsheens in the late winter of 147.
You: Our people have been tormented by a fearsome foe. ... This vile fiend has killed sixteen in her lust for murder!
chronicle_voice_rules: Subject-first, present tense, bare verbs: 'X stands up.' 'X begins playing make believe.'
Named individuals get full procedurally generated names (Urist + compound epithets like Twilightdream the Subtlety of Quandaries).
Body-generic references: 'the broad-chin elf monk', 'Protruding-eyes elf monk' — descriptor adjectives attach directly to species nouns.
No exclamation except dread moments (siege, fey mood, beast). Calm events end in periods even when remarkable.
Kills are tallied with quiet arithmetic: 'This vile fiend has killed sixteen in her lust for murder!'
Reaction lines are flat and fatalistic: 'It was inevitable.' 'It is terrifying.'

shapes.adjective_grammar_example: [SHAPE:STAR] takes [ADJ:three-pointed|four-pointed|five-pointed|many-pointed]; [SHAPE:MOON] takes [ADJ:hidden|full|crescent] — shapes carry small modifier pools

patterns.eye_grammar: iris/pupil patterns are always 3 CP_COLOR slots: [WHITE, BLACK, <iris color>] — structural colors fixed, one variable slot. 132 iris + 132 pupil = one per standard color.

text_set_dialogue_grammar.format: [TEXT_SET:NAME] followed by one line per variant; placeholders in [CONTEXT:...] / [SPEAKER:...] tags

examples.CURSE: Who dares to enter my house?  I curse you!
examples.ANIMAL_SLAYER: I have taken down [CONTEXT:NUMBER] [CONTEXT:RACE:NUMBERED_NAME] while stalking [CONTEXT:PLACE:TRANS_NAME].
examples.HIST_FIG_SLAYER: It is I that felled [CONTEXT:HIST_FIG:TRANS_NAME] the [CONTEXT:HIST_FIG:RACE].
